title: Draft-then-publish callers still publish without the draftVersion pin #36350 added (Studio save bar, design-mode menu, record tabs, extension arrangement, admin detail save, client publishItem)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsSBHy5paNUz6zke9Re

Filing gate: ① a product defect with named locations (one card for one family) · Source: fleet. This is follow-up work owed by landed work: PR #37387 (#36350, ruling 7168616260 A1). It was reported by its dev (7179271525) and confirmed by its contract review (7179921339 ③, 7181638537).

## What happens

PR #37387 gave the per-item publish door an optional `draftVersion` pin. A publish that names the draft version it wrote or read is refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` when that draft moved, so an unreviewed draft is never published on someone else's behalf (ruling 7058616478, #35955). Ruling item 3 scoped that PR to four callers. These other draft-then-publish callers on `main` still publish unpinned, so the window #36350 closed for "Save to this view" stays open on them:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx` (two publish sites)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/detailSaveAtOnce.ts`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfigSave.ts`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` (two publish sites)
- `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.publishItem` cannot state either pin (`draftVersion` or `parentVersion`).

Line positions are as the dev read them at #37387's head. Re-check on claim: `git grep -n "publishDraft\|\.publish(" ui/packages/app-shell/src/views` against `git grep -n "draftVersion" ui/packages/app-shell/src/views`.

reach: read from code per caller. Not reproduced per caller. The door-level harm was measured on #36350: an interleaved draft write between a draft write and its unpinned publish went live (report 7164597391, M1). Each caller here is a draft write followed by an unpinned publish of the same address, so the measured mechanism applies. The claimer reproduces one caller before code.

## Expected

Each caller passes the version of the draft it wrote (its own draft receipt) or showed. It never re-reads blindly, because a re-read would pin someone else's draft. `@objectstack/client`'s `publishItem` accepts `draftVersion` (and `parentVersion`) beside `message`. The pattern is #37387's "Save to this view" and draft bar.

## Done when

- Every caller listed above (re-checked on claim) pins, with one pin per caller in that caller's existing harness: an interleaved draft write is refused and nothing unreviewed is published. A CONTROL shows the uninterleaved publish still promotes.
- Callers found on claim that #37387 did not list are added or named as out of scope with a reason.

## Notes

- Also from #37387's review, outside this card's mechanism but on the same files: nit N6. After a refused Save resolved by "reload" in `DraftConflictDialog`, the runtime draft bar keeps the old token, so its Publish fails closed until the panel is reopened. It can ride this card when `DraftConflictDialog.tsx` is touched.
- Grading suggestion: p2, the same harm as #36350 on narrower paths; triage confirms.

Dedupe: open and closed issues for `draftVersion publish callers` (1: #36350), `studioSaveBar publish unpinned draft` (2: #36726 closed, #36350), `draft-then-publish pin` (112, top hits #36963 open, #36726, #36350, #36137). #36963 (Studio create doors for a new object, permission set and app) is the same family on create doors, not these save callers. No open card covers these callers.
